# Subset EC
## Clustering 
```{r subset_EC}
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS("./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")
table(seurat.combined.sct$renamed_cluster)
seurat.combined.sct <- NormalizeData(seurat.combined.sct, assay = "RNA")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
EC.cells <- subset(seurat.combined.sct, idents = c("Endothelial Cell"))
saveRDS(EC.cells,file.path(data_dir,paste0("EC.cells.rds")))

# split condition
split_seurat <- SplitObject(EC.cells, split.by = "sample")
split_seurat <- split_seurat[c("Chow","HFSC")]

seurat.list <- lapply(X = split_seurat, FUN = SCTransform, verbose = FALSE)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat.list , nfeatures = 3000)
seurat.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = seurat.list, anchor.features = features)
seurat.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat.list, normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)
seurat.combined.sct.EC <- IntegrateData(anchorset = seurat.anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
seurat.combined.sct.EC <- RunPCA(seurat.combined.sct.EC, verbose = FALSE)

# ElbowPlot
png(filename = './subset_EC/EC_ElbowPlot.png')
ElbowPlot(seurat.combined.sct.EC, ndim = 30)
dev.off()

ndims <- 20
seurat.combined.sct.EC <- RunUMAP(seurat.combined.sct.EC, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:ndims)
seurat.combined.sct.EC <- FindNeighbors(seurat.combined.sct.EC, dims = 1:ndims, verbose = FALSE)
seurat.combined.sct.EC <- FindClusters(seurat.combined.sct.EC, verbose = FALSE, resolution = seq(0.1,1,0.1))
seurat.combined.sct.EC <- FindClusters(seurat.combined.sct.EC, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.2)
for(res in seq(0.1,1,0.1)){
  cat("#### res:",res, "\n")
  Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC) <- paste0("integrated_snn_res.", res)
  png(filename = sprintf('./subset_EC/res_new_%s.png', res))
  p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct.EC, label = T)
  print(p2)
  dev.off()
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
}

# cell counts 
metadata = seurat.combined.sct.EC@meta.data 
png(filename = './subset_EC/cell_counts_newcutoff.png')
metadata %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample, fill=sample)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  ggtitle("NCells")
dev.off()

```

## Annotation
```{r EC_annotation}
getwd()
#seurat.combined.sct.EC <- readRDS("./subset_EC/data/2024-07-01/seurat_combined_sct_umap_EC_renamed.rds")
# 本来想用这些general marker来区分cluster，没成功，乱的一批
# 所以回到各个cluster的marker中来看富集到的功能
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC) <-  "integrated_snn_res.0.6"
table(seurat.combined.sct.EC$integrated_snn_res.0.6)
assignment_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = c("0","1","5","9",
              "2","6","8","11","12",
              "3",
              "4",
              "7",
              "10",
              "14",
              "13"), 
  sub_cluster = c(
    rep("REC",4),   #这里的名称原来是1,2,3,4的编号，在富集功能鉴定出主要细胞类型之后，再替换成的名字
    rep("IREC",5),
    rep("MesEC",1),
    rep("IEC",1),
    rep("VEC",1),
    rep("MbEC",1),
    rep("LEC",1),
    rep("NA",1)
  )
)
print(assignment_df)
assignment_df$sub_cluster = as.character(assignment_df$sub_cluster)
temp_meta <- seurat.combined.sct.EC@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>% 
  left_join(assignment_df, by = c("integrated_snn_res.0.6" = "cluster")) %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "barcode")
colnames(temp_meta)
temp_meta <- temp_meta[,-34] # 没这三行不行哦
colnames(temp_meta)[34] <- "sub_cluster" # 没这三行不行哦
colnames(temp_meta) # 没这三行不行哦
seurat.combined.sct.EC$sub_cluster <- temp_meta[rownames(seurat.combined.sct.EC@meta.data),"sub_cluster"]
table(seurat.combined.sct.EC$sub_cluster)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC) <-  "sub_cluster"
DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct.EC, label = T) 

saveRDS(seurat.combined.sct.EC, file = file.path(data_dir, "seurat_combined_sct_umap_EC.rds"))

# 去掉NA因为这个细胞绝对不是EC nNA = 40
table(seurat.combined.sct.EC$sub_cluster)
cells_to_remove <- WhichCells(seurat.combined.sct.EC, idents = "NA")
seurat.combined.sct.EC.new <- subset(seurat.combined.sct.EC, cells = cells_to_remove, invert = TRUE)
DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, label = T) 
sort(table(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sub_cluster), decreasing = T)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "sub_cluster"
levels(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- c("REC","IREC","MesEC","IEC","VEC","MbEC","LEC")

saveRDS(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, file = file.path(data_dir, "seurat_combined_sct_umap_EC_new.rds"))

# Markers
seurat.combined.sct.EC.new <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new)
EC.markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
#write.csv(EC.markers ,file = sprintf('./subset_EC/EC_marker.csv'), row.names = T)
write.csv(EC.markers ,file = sprintf('./subset_EC/EC_marker_renamed.csv'), row.names = T)
table(EC.markers$cluster)
EC.markers.sig <- EC.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = -30, wt = p_val)
EC.markers.top20 <- EC.markers.sig %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)
EC.markers.top20 <- data.frame(symbol=EC.markers.top20$gene,EC.markers.top20[,1:6])
EC.markers.top10 <- EC.markers.sig %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)
#write.csv(EC.markers.top20,file = sprintf('./subset_EC/EC_marker_top10.csv'), row.names = F)
write.csv(EC.markers.top20,file = sprintf('./subset_EC/EC_marker_top10_renamed.csv'), row.names = F)

# REC: Resting Endothelial Cell
# EPC: Endothelial Progenitor Cell 
# IMC: Inflammatory Endothelial Cell "Icam1", "Vcam1", "Sele"
# VEC: Vascular Endothelial Cell
# MesEC: Mesenchymal-endothelial Cell
# MbEC: Metabolic Endothelial Cells
# LEC: Lymphatic Endothelial Cell "Lyve1", "Prox1", "Pdpn" 

#seurat.combined.sct.EC$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(seurat.combined.sct.EC$seurat_clusters)
#seurat.combined.sct.EC$renamed_cluster <- as.factor(seurat.combined.sct.EC$renamed_cluster)

seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sample_simple <- stringi::stri_sub(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$orig.ident,-4,-1)
seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$DE_subgroup <- paste0(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sub_cluster, "-", seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sample_simple)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "DE_subgroup"
table(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$DE_subgroup)

as.data.frame(table(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$DE_subgroup)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(group = Var1, number_of_cells = Freq) %>% 
  DT::datatable()
```

## Marker umap
```{r marker_umap}
markers.to.plot = c("Lyve1", "Prox1", "Pdpn") # LEC
markers.to.plot = c("Cd34", "Kdr", "Prom1", "Cxcr4", "Tek") #EPC
markers.to.plot = c("Icam1", "Vcam1", "Sele", "Cxcl9", "Rsad2")
markers.to.plot = c("Cdh5","Pecam1","Vwf","Nos3","Flt1")
markers.to.plot = c("Angpt2","Flk1")
markers.to.plot = c("Cd74","Vcam1","Cysltr1","Selp","Sele")
markers.to.plot = c("Cma1","Bcl2a1b","Tpsb2","Ctsk")

DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "sub_cluster"
for(gene in markers.to.plot){
  if(gene %in% rownames(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new)){
    cat("### ",gene, "\n")
    png(filename = sprintf('./subset_EC/markers_0701/markers_allsimple_%s.png', gene), width=10, height=5, units="in", res=300)
    p <- FeaturePlot(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, 
                     features = gene, reduction = "umap",
                     order = TRUE,
                     label = TRUE,
                     min.cutoff = "q10",
                     split.by = "DE_group")
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    cat("\n")
  }
  else{
    cat("### ",gene, " \n")
    cat("Not present in dataset \n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

### stacked barplot 2
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ----- Palette (hue = EC subcluster; shade = diet) -----
base_cols <- c(
  REC   = "#6F99AD",
  IREC  = "#0171B5",
  MesEC = "#7876B1",
  IEC   = "#BC3B29",
  VEC   = "#FFDC90",
  MbEC  = "#1F864E",
  LEC   = "#E18728"
)

fill_map <- c(
  setNames(base_cols,              paste0(names(base_cols), ".Chow")),
  setNames(alpha(base_cols, 0.45), paste0(names(base_cols), ".HFSC"))
)

# ----- Build count table from metadata -----
meta <- seurat.combined.sct.EC.new@meta.data
ct_levels <- rev(c("REC","IREC","MesEC","IEC","VEC","MbEC","LEC"))

df <- meta %>%
  count(`Cell Types` = sub_cluster, Groups = sample_simple, name = "Numbers") %>%
  filter(Groups %in% c("Chow","HFSC")) %>%
  mutate(
    `Cell Types` = factor(`Cell Types`, levels = ct_levels),
    Groups = factor(Groups, levels = c("Chow","HFSC")),
    fill_id = interaction(`Cell Types`, Groups, sep = ".")
  )

# ----- Left panel: absolute counts (Chow above HFSC) -----
C2 <- ggplot(df, aes(y = `Cell Types`, x = Numbers, fill = fill_id)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Numbers),
    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, reverse = TRUE),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 5)
  ) +
  xlab("Numbers") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# ----- Right panel data: within-group proportions -----
dfp <- df %>%
  group_by(Groups) %>%
  mutate(pct = Numbers / sum(Numbers)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Control stack order (flip if desired)
stack_order <- rev(levels(df$`Cell Types`))

dfp <- dfp %>%
  mutate(
    fill_id = factor(
      as.character(fill_id),
      levels = c(paste0(stack_order, ".Chow"),
                 paste0(stack_order, ".HFSC"))
    )
  )

stopifnot(sum(is.na(dfp$fill_id)) == 0)

# ----- Right panel: stacked proportions (0–1 axis) -----
D2 <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = Groups, y = Numbers, fill = fill_id)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 0.03, percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 1.8, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.line    = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  xlab("Groups")

# ----- Combine & export -----

    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8))
```

# Go enrich - Cluster identification
```{r go_enrich}
## 1. Prepare gene lists per cluster
# Split genes per cluster
gene.list.by.cluster <- split(EC.markers.top20$symbol, EC.markers.top20$cluster)

## 2. Run GO enrichment per cluster (with clusterProfiler)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
#if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#    install.packages("BiocManager")
# BiocManager::install("org.Mm.eg.db")
# BiocManager::install("clusterProfiler")
# Optional: convert gene symbols to Entrez ID
convert_to_entrez <- function(gene_symbols) {
  bitr(gene_symbols, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Mm.eg.db")
}
go.results <- list()
for (cl in names(gene.list.by.cluster)) {
  gene.symbols <- gene.list.by.cluster[[cl]]
  converted <- convert_to_entrez(gene.symbols)
  if (nrow(converted) > 0) {
    ego <- enrichGO(gene         = converted$ENTREZID,
                    OrgDb        = org.Mm.eg.db,
                    keyType      = "ENTREZID",
                    ont          = "BP",
                    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                    qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                    readable      = TRUE)
    go.results[[cl]] <- ego
  }
}

## 3. Visualize
dotplot(go.results[["IEC"]], showCategory = 10, title = "GO BP: IEC") 
for (cl in names(go.results)) {
  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat("Cluster", cl, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")
  print(head(go.results[[cl]]@result[, c("Description", "p.adjust", "geneID")]))
}
all.go.results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(go.results), function(cl) {
  df <- go.results[[cl]]@result
  df$Cluster <- cl
  return(df)
}))
write.csv(all.go.results, file = paste0(results_dir,"/All_GO_BP_Enrichment_by_Cluster.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)
seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sub_cluster <- factor(
  seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sub_cluster,levels = c("REC","IREC","MesEC","IEC","VEC","MbEC","LEC"))
p1 <- DotPlot(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, 
              features = rev(EC.markers.top20$symbol), 
              dot.scale = 8,
              cols = "RdBu",
              group.by = "sub_cluster") + 
  RotatedAxis() + 
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "mm"),
    strip.text = element_text(margin = margin(b = 3, unit = "mm")),
    strip.placement = 'outlet',
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Subcluster", y = "Marker Genes", title = "Cell Markers") +
  coord_flip()
p1
top3path <- read.csv("./subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/top3_plot_input.csv")
top3path$Cluster <- plyr::mapvalues(
  top3path$Cluster,
  from = c("REC", "IREC", "MesEC", "IEC", "VEC", "MbEC","LEC"),
  to   = c("REC", "IREC", "MesEC", "IEC", "VEC", "MbEC","LEC")
)

# Color assignment
mycol <- c("#ff595e", "#ff924c", "#ffca3a", "#8ac926", "#00c2c2", "#5197d9", "#635ccc")
names(mycol) <- c("REC", "IREC", "MesEC", "IEC", "VEC", "MbEC","LEC")

# Set factor levels for consistent ordering
top3path$Cluster <- factor(top3path$Cluster, levels = names(mycol))
top3path <- top3path %>%
  mutate(Description = fct_rev(Description))  # Reverse y-axis for bar alignment

# GO Barplot
top3path2 <- top3path %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = c("REC", "IREC", "MesEC", "IEC", "VEC", "MbEC","LEC")),
    y_id = paste(Cluster, Description, sep = " — ")  # 组合因子，避免全局冲突
  ) %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    y_id = fct_reorder(y_id, p.adjust, .desc = TRUE) # p小（-log10大）的排在上面
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p2 <- ggplot(top3path2, aes(x = -log10(p.adjust), y = y_id, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Description), hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.2, size = 3.2, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Cluster, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(x = expression(-log[10](p.adjust)), fill = "Cluster")

# layout
combined_plot <- p1 + p2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1,1))
ggsave(paste0(results_dir, "/pathway_plot.pdf"), combined_plot, width = 8, height = 12)
```

# AUCell score in EC subcluster
```{r AUCell_EC}
library(Biobase)
library(AUCell)
library(GSEABase)
library(ggrastr)
getwd()
# dir.create("AUCell/EC_subcluster")

#Run AUCell
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "sub_cluster"
combined.small <- subset(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, downsample = 3000)
fmeta <- data.frame(symbol = rownames(combined.small)) 
rownames(fmeta) <- fmeta$symbol
eset_combined.small <- new("ExpressionSet",
                           assayData = assayDataNew("environment", exprs=combined.small@assays$RNA@layers$counts, 
                                                    norm_exprs = combined.small@assays$RNA@layers$data),
                           phenoData =  new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = combined.small@meta.data),
                           featureData = new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = fmeta))
class(eset_combined.small)

exprMatrix <- Biobase::exprs(eset_combined.small)
geneSets <- getGmt("./AUCell/mh.all.v2023.2.Mm.symbols.gmt")
geneSets <- subsetGeneSets(geneSets, rownames(exprMatrix)) 
cbind(nGenes(geneSets))
geneSets <- setGeneSetNames(geneSets, newNames=paste(names(geneSets)))

# add random noise
# Random
set.seed(321)
extraGeneSets <- c(
  GeneSet(sample(rownames(exprMatrix), 50), setName="Random (50g)"),
  GeneSet(sample(rownames(exprMatrix), 500), setName="Random (500g)"))
countsPerGene <- apply(exprMatrix, 1, function(x) sum(x>0))
# Housekeeping-like
extraGeneSets <- c(extraGeneSets,
                   GeneSet(sample(names(countsPerGene)[which(countsPerGene>quantile(countsPerGene, probs=.95))], 100), 
                           setName="HK-like (100g)"))
geneSets <- GeneSetCollection(c(geneSets,extraGeneSets))
names(geneSets)

# "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS" "HALLMARK_ANGIOGENESIS" "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS" "HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM" "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE" "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING" "HALLMARK_NOTCH_SIGNALING" "HALLMARK_PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING" "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY" "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"
```

## 1. Score gene signatures
```{r AUCell_score}
cells_rankings <- AUCell_buildRankings(exprMatrix, plotStats=FALSE)
cells_rankings
# save(cells_rankings, file="./AUCell/EC_subcluster/cells_rankings.RData")

cells_AUC <- AUCell_calcAUC(geneSets, cells_rankings)
# save(cells_AUC, file="./AUCell/EC_subcluster/AUCecells_AUC.RData")
```

## 2. Determine the cells with the active gene sets
```{r AUCell_cell}
set.seed(123)
par(mfrow=c(3,3)) 
cells_assignment <- AUCell_exploreThresholds(cells_AUC, plotHist=FALSE, assign=TRUE)
# save(cells_assignment, file="./AUCell/EC_subcluster/cellassignment_AUC.RData")
```

# Differential Expression Analysis in EC subclusters
## Input data
```{r multiV_input}
table(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$DE_subgroup)
sort(table(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$sub_cluster),decreasing = T)
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "DE_subgroup"

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# Define the cell types
cell_types <- c("REC", "IREC", "MesEC", "IEC", "VEC", "MbEC", "LEC")
# Define the conditions
condition1 <- "HFSC"
condition2 <- "Chow"
# Initialize an empty list to store data frames
markers_list <- list()
# Loop through each cell type and perform the operations
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  # Join the layers (if needed, you might skip this if it's already done)
  seurat.combined.sct.EC.new <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new)
  # Create the identifiers for the conditions
  ident1 <- paste(cell_type, condition1, sep = "-")
  ident2 <- paste(cell_type, condition2, sep = "-")
  # Find markers
  markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, ident.1 = ident1, ident.2 = ident2)
  # Convert markers to data frame and arrange by adjusted p-value
  markers_df <- markers %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
    arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
    mutate(CellTypes = cell_type)
  # Save the results
  saveRDS(markers_df, file = file.path("./subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/DEAnalysis", paste(cell_type, "-DEMarkers.rds", sep = "")))
  # Append the data frame to the list
  markers_list[[cell_type]] <- markers_df
}

# Combine all data frames in the list into one data frame
combined_markers_df <- bind_rows(markers_list)
write.csv(combined_markers_df,"./subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/DEAnalysis/combined_markers_df.csv",row.names = F)
combined_markers_df <- read.csv("./subset_EC/results/2024-07-01/DEAnalysis/combined_markers_df.csv")

# Display the combined data frame
combined_markers_df_P0.1 <- combined_markers_df %>%
  filter((avg_log2FC > 1 | avg_log2FC < -1) & p_val < 0.1)
table(combined_markers_df_P0.1$CellTypes)
multiVolcano_input <- combined_markers_df_P0.1[,c("gene","p_val","avg_log2FC","CellTypes")]
colnames(multiVolcano_input) <- c("Name","PValue","logFC","Cluster")
```

## MultiVolcano
```{r multiVolcano}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)   # 用于标记

mycol <- c("#6F99AD","#0072B5","#7876B1","#BC3C28","#FFDC91","#1F854E","#E18727")

# 自定义一个函数，之后我们直接调用它
mutiVolcano = function(df,         # 绘图数据
                       P,   # P值卡值
                       logFC,   # logFC卡值
                       GroupName,      # 分组标签
                       pointColor, # 分组散点的颜色
                       barFill = "#efefef",  # 柱子的颜色
                       pointSize = 0.5,      # 散点的大小
                       labeltype = "1",      # 标记差异基因的选项，标记类型有"1"和"2"两种选项
                       labelNum = 5,         # 当标记类型为1时，待标记的散点个数
                       labelName = NULL,      # 当标记类型为2时，待标记的散点名称
                       tileLabel =  "Label", # 标记比较对的选项，选项有“Label”和“Num”，Label时显示分组名称，Num时显示数字，防止因为标签太长导致的不美观
                       tileLable_size,
                       tileColor = NULL      # 比较对的颜色
                       ){
  # 数据分组 根据p的卡值分组
  dfSig = df %>%
    filter(logFC>{{logFC}} | logFC <((-1)*{{logFC}})) %>%
    mutate(Group = ifelse(PValue<{{P}},GroupName[[1]],GroupName[[2]])) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group,levels=GroupName)) %>%
    mutate(Cluster = factor(Cluster,levels=unique(Cluster)))   # Cluster的顺序是文件中出现的顺序
  
  # 柱形图数据整理
  dfBar = dfSig %>%
    group_by(Cluster) %>%
    summarise(min = min(logFC,na.rm = T),
              max = max(logFC,na.rm = T)
              )
  # 散点图数据整理
  dfJitter = dfSig %>%
    mutate(jitter = jitter(as.numeric(Cluster),factor = 2))
  dfJitter
  
  # 整理标记差异基因的数据
  if(labeltype == "1"){
    # 标记一
    # 每组P值最小的几个
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>%
      group_by(Cluster) %>%
      slice_max(abs(logFC),n=labelNum,with_ties = F) %>%
      ungroup()
  }else if(labeltype == "2"){
    # 标记二
    # 指定标记
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>%
      filter(Name %in% labelName)
  }else{
    dfLabel = dfJitter %>% slice()
  }
    
  # 绘图
  p = ggplot()+
    # 绘制柱形图
    geom_col(data = dfBar,aes(x=Cluster,y=max),fill = barFill)+
    geom_col(data = dfBar,aes(x=Cluster,y=min),fill = barFill)+
    # 绘制散点图
    geom_point(data = dfJitter,
               aes(x = jitter, y = logFC, color = Group),
               size = pointSize,
               show.legend = NA
               )+
    # 绘制中间的标签方块
    ggplot2::geom_tile(data = dfSig,
                       ggplot2::aes(x = Cluster, y = 0, fill = Cluster), 
                       color = "black",
                       height = 1.5,
                       # alpha = 0.3,
                       show.legend = NA,
                       ) + 
    # 标记差异基因
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = dfLabel,
      aes(x = jitter,                   # geom_text_repel 标记函数
          y = logFC,          
          label=Name),        
      min.segment.length = 0.1,
      max.overlaps = 10000,               # 最大覆盖率，当点很多时，有些标记会被覆盖，调大该值则不被覆盖，反之。
      size=2.5,                             # 字体大小
      box.padding=unit(0.5,'lines'),      # 标记的边距
      point.padding=unit(0.05, 'lines'), 
      segment.color='black',              # 标记线条的颜色
      show.legend=F)
  
  if(tileLabel=="Label"){
     p =
      p +
      geom_text(data = dfSig,aes(x = Cluster,y = 0,label = Cluster),size = tileLable_size)+
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = tileColor,
                                 guide = NULL # 不显示该图例
                                 )
  }else if(tileLabel=="Num"){
    # 如果比较对的名字太长，可以改成数字标签
    p =
      p +
      geom_text(data = dfSig,aes(x = Cluster,y = 0,label = as.numeric(Cluster)),show.legend = NA)+
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = tileColor,
                                 labels = c(paste0(1:length(unique(dfSig$Cluster)),": ",unique(dfSig$Cluster))))
  }

  # 修改主题
  p = p+ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = pointColor)+
    theme_classic()+
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 5) + 
    ggplot2::theme(
                   legend.position = "right", 
                   legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(), 
                   legend.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                   axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                   # axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                   axis.line.x = element_blank()
                   ) + 
    ggplot2::xlab("Clusters") + ggplot2::ylab("log2FC") + 
    # ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend())
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
    return(p)
}

df <- as_tibble(multiVolcano_input)
# Run multiVolcano
mutiVolcano(
  df = df,    # 绘图数据
  P = 0.05,   # P值卡值
  logFC = 1,   # FC卡值
  GroupName = c("P-value < 0.05","P-value >= 0.05"),      # 分组标签
  pointColor = c("#dc143c","#0099CC"), # 分组散点的颜色
  barFill = "#efefef",   # 柱子的颜色
  pointSize = 0.3,   # 散点的大小
  labeltype = "1",   # 标记差异基因的选项，标记类型有"1"和"2"两种选项:
                     # 当标记类型为1时，待标记的散点个数:当标记类型为2时，待标记的散点名称
  tileLable_size = 2.8,
  tileLabel =  "Label",           # 标记比较对的选项，选项有“Label”和“Num”，Label时显示分组名称，
                                  # Num时显示数字，防止因为标签太长导致的不美观
  tileColor = mycol  # 比较对的颜色
  ) +
  labs(title="Distribution of Differentially Expressed Genes \nin Individual EC Subpopulations")
ggsave("./subset_EC/mutiVolcano.pdf", width = 6, height = 4)
```


```{r DEA_EC}
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <-"RNA"
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new) <- "DE_subgroup"
table(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new$DE_subgroup)
```

```{r DE_loop}
# Define the identifiers and file names
identifiers <- c("REC","IREC","MesEC","IEC","VEC","MbEC","LEC")
conditions <- c("HFSC", "Chow")
date <- "2024-07-01"

# Create a directory for saving results if it doesn't exist
dir.create(file.path("./subset_EC/data", date), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path("./subset_EC/results", date), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Loop through the identifiers to perform the differential expression analysis and save results
for (id in identifiers) {
  seurat.combined.sct.EC.new <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.EC.new)
  markers <- FindMarkers(object = seurat.combined.sct.EC.new, ident.1 = paste0(id, "-HFSC"), ident.2 = paste0(id, "-Chow"))
  markers_df <- markers %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj)
  
  # Save the full results
  saveRDS(markers_df, file = file.path("./subset_EC/data", date, paste0("markers_", id, ".rds")))
  rio::export(markers_df, file = file.path("./subset_EC/results", date, paste0("DE_results_", id, "-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")))
  
  # Save the significant results
  markers_df_sig <- markers_df %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05)
  rio::export(markers_df_sig, file = file.path("./subset_EC/results", date, paste0("DE_results_", id, "-HFSC_vs_Chow_sig05.csv")))
  print(nrow(markers_df_sig))
}

```
